Not vendored (plan §3.4 / Phase 08)
-----------------------------------
- overlay / input / hotkey code
- `@/web/Config` (AppConfig)
- `@/web/background/TradeData` (trade-site query client)
- Vite-hosted `items.ndjson` / `stats.ndjson` (not present in the EE2 git tree;
  loaded at runtime via `import.meta.env.BASE_URL`)

Why parseClipboard is not executed
----------------------------------
`Parser.ts` imports `@/web/Config` and `@/assets/data`. The data module then
imports `@/web/background/TradeData` and fetches Vite-bundled ndjson. Vendoring
or calling that path would pull undocumented trade-site clients, which Phase 08
forbids. `packages/core/src/items/parseItem.ts` is the Node adapter: English
clipboard section grammar from EE2 `itemTextToSections` / `parseNamePlate`,
mapped to `NormalizedItem`. Vendored `parser/meta.ts` (no upstream imports) is
the only compiled vendor module.
